title: Annett's Mono Village Campground

services.name: Camp Sites
services.desc: Our Entire Campground (Both Hook-up & Dry camp sites) is operated on a “first-come, first-served” basis. There are NO reservations taken on ANY of our campground sites. There is a maximum of eight persons per site. That includes children and infants. Electric Vehicle and e-bike charging is not allowed. Water, sewer, and electricity. $45 per day for 2 people, plus tax, $3 per day for each additional person. There is a .50c per day pet fee (Up to 2 pets) for all dry and hook up sites. Monthly rate is $15.00; Seasonal rate is $75.00. Please Be Advised: Our resort, as well as the surrounding areas, are home to multiple types of wildlife, including bears. services.name: Cabin 1
services.desc: All of our rentals are completely furnished and equipped housekeeping units with a bathroom and fully equipped kitchen. Smaller rustic cabins do not have a sink in the bathroom, but sinks are installed in the kitchens of ALL units. Bedding, linens, towels & kitchen necessities (pots, pans, dishes, utensils, toaster, coffee maker) are provided. Each unit has an outside firepit and picnic table. Microwaves are provided in cabins. Please be advised that the “basics” such as dish soap, paper towels, garbage sacks, etc. are not provided in any unit and are the responsibility of our guests. It is the responsibility of guests to remove their own waste from units and dispose of in nearby dumpsters.

blurb: Mono Village, located on Upper Twin Lake, is a fishermen’s haven and family vacation hideaway. Nestled in one of the most scenic and rugged areas in the Eastern Sierras, Mono Village rests at an elevation of 7,100 feet and is easily reached from Bridgeport, California. To find us, take Twin Lakes Road out of Bridgeport. Follow 14 miles to the very end of the pavement.
